To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a specific whole blood-derived miRNA signature was observed in mice exposed to different LPS from gram-negative bacteria, but not to lipoteichoic acids from gram-positive bacteria.
we identified a specific whole-blood-derived miRNA signature in the mouse model that was induced by exposure to LPS from Gram-negative bacteria.
a whole-blood miRNA signature in response to LPS exposure in mice was identified.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of whole blood–derived biomarkers for LPM exposure and the development of a rapid, accurate and sensitive method to identify the presence of gram-negative bacterial infections.
the identification of miRNAs in whole blood that can be used to detect the presence of LPS in the circulation.
the identification of a whole blood–derived signature of miRNA expression in mice exposed to a variety of gram-negative bacteria.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
miRNA expression in the whole blood is a promising approach for the early detection of LPS exposure.
the whole blood-derived miRNA signatures in mice following LPS injection are promising as biomarker for the early detection of LPS exposure.
these miRNAs are not only biomarkers of LPS exposure but also potential mediators of sepsis pathogenesis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the expression of these miRNAs in whole blood is specific to LPS, dose- and time-related, and independent of the type of bacteria, and that the miRNAs are regulated by TLR4.
miRNA expression in whole blood may be a useful biomarker for LPS-induced inflammation.
the miRNA signature of LPS exposure in whole blood can be used as a biomarker for sepsis and that this signature may be a potential therapeutic target in septic patients.
The main takeaway from our work is that
whole blood is a promising source of miRNA for biomarker development.
the whole blood is a good source of miRNAs for the study of LPS-induced sepsis.
the whole blood miRNA profile may be used to detect LPS exposure.
